title: HOW A CRASH SIGNAL FAILS!!! SPY TO $800!
speaker: Money Making Market host

macro_themes.view: The daily lower-high sell signal on SPY was violated by a 2-hour MACD cross up, so the bearish setup is failing and upside to new highs is favoured.
TLT broke 82.50, a level held since 2002, with no reversal signals: expect more downside in bond prices.

notes: Weekend video, no date stated; listing approx_date used.
